cases.name: the user profile deploys into a workshop what the synchronisation deployed before lot 11 from the same tree less packs/, plus the profile definitions under .claude/harness/profiles/ (Δ = 0 for the session)
cases.cmd:
. {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{ROOT}} {{CLAUDE}} {{FIX}}/{{SID}}
need_sync; [ -d "$H/profiles/packs" ] && [ -d "$H/claude/hooks" ] || { printf 'ok (skipped: the harness tree is not here)'; exit 0; }
mkdir -p "$F/now" "$F/old" "$F/a" "$F/b" || exit 1
(cd "$H" && tar cf - --exclude=./evals/.fixtures .) | (cd "$F/now" && tar xf -) || exit 1
(cd "$H" && tar cf - --exclude=./evals/.fixtures --exclude=./packs --exclude=./profiles .) | (cd "$F/old" && tar xf -) || exit 1
HARNESS_STAGING=$F/now sy "$F/a" >/dev/null || fail 'sync of the profiles tree failed'
HARNESS_STAGING=$F/old sy "$F/b" >/dev/null || fail 'sync of the old tree failed'
d=$(diff -r -q -x '.harness-*' "$F/a" "$F/b")
[ "$d" = "Only in $F/a/.claude/harness: profiles" ] || fail "$d"
[ ! -e "$F/a/.claude/local" ] && [ ! -e "$F/a/.claude/.harness-space" ] || fail 'state written for user'
printf 'ok'

cases.name: dev in a checkout: the source and dev files are deployed into .claude/, no seed and no workshop folder, a delimited block of .git/info/exclude lists them, and git status stays clean
cases.cmd:
. {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{ROOT}} {{CLAUDE}} {{FIX}}/{{SID}}
need_sync; mkstg; r=$F/r; mkrepo "$r" https://github.com/Orkeon/orkeon.git
out=$(wp "$r" dev) || fail "$out"
printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qF '[harness] synchronised into' || fail "$out"
for f in .claude/skills/dev-probe/SKILL.md .claude/agents/dev-probe.md .claude/rules/source-space.md .claude/rules/orkeon-probe.md \
         .claude/harness/packs/repo-orkeon/references/repo.yaml .claude/settings.json .claude/hooks/probe.sh .claude/skills/workshop-profile/SKILL.md; do
  [ -f "$r/$f" ] || fail "missing $f"
done
for f in CLAUDE.md .gitignore .gitattributes teams workbooks .claude/harness/HARNESS.md .claude/skills/team-probe .claude/rules/ws-probe.md .claude/skills/docs-audit-probe; do
  [ ! -e "$r/$f" ] || fail "present: $f"
done
[ "$(. "$C/lib/team-common.sh"; harness_space "$r")" = source ] || fail 'the space the synchronisation wrote is not the one the hooks read'
[ -z "$(git -C "$r" status --porcelain)" ] || fail "git status: $(git -C "$r" status --porcelain)"
mkdir -p "$r/todo/x" && printf 's\n' > "$r/todo/x/SPEC-x.md"
[ -z "$(git -C "$r" status --porcelain)" ] || fail 'todo/ shows'
out=$(sy "$r") || fail "$out"
printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qF '[harness] up to date' || fail "second start: $out"
ex=$r/.git/info/exclude; top=$(git -C "$r" rev-parse --show-toplevel)
[ "$(grep -cxF "# >>> orkeon-workshop harness $top" "$ex")" = 1 ] && [ "$(grep -cxF "# <<< orkeon-workshop harness $top" "$ex")" = 1 ] || fail "$(cat "$ex")"
[ "$(grep -c '^# [<>]\{3\} orkeon-workshop harness' "$ex")" = 2 ] || fail "$(cat "$ex")"
grep -qx '/.claude/skills/dev-probe/SKILL.md' "$ex" && grep -qx '/todo/' "$ex" && grep -qx '/.claude/local/' "$ex" || fail "$(cat "$ex")"
printf 'ok'

cases.name: switching a checkout from dev to docs removes the dev files and their lines of the exclude block, deploys the docs ones, and git status stays clean
cases.cmd:
. {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{ROOT}} {{CLAUDE}} {{FIX}}/{{SID}}
need_sync; mkstg; r=$F/r; mkrepo "$r" https://github.com/acme/thing.git
printf '# mine\n' > "$r/.git/info/exclude"
wp "$r" dev >/dev/null || fail dev
out=$(wp "$r" docs) || fail "$out"
printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qE '\[harness\] synchronised into .*[1-9][0-9]* removed' || fail "$out"
[ ! -e "$r/.claude/skills/dev-probe" ] && [ ! -e "$r/.claude/agents/dev-probe.md" ] && [ -f "$r/.claude/skills/docs-audit-probe/SKILL.md" ] || fail 'files'
! grep -q dev-probe "$r/.git/info/exclude" && grep -qx '# mine' "$r/.git/info/exclude" || fail "$(cat "$r/.git/info/exclude")"
[ -z "$(git -C "$r" status --porcelain)" ] || fail "git status: $(git -C "$r" status --porcelain)"
printf 'ok'

cases.name: a checkout that tracks a target: the synchronisation refuses the whole deployment with exit 2 and names the file, and writes nothing
cases.cmd:
. {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{ROOT}} {{CLAUDE}} {{FIX}}/{{SID}}
need_sync; mkstg; r=$F/r; mkrepo "$r" https://github.com/acme/thing.git
mkdir -p "$r/.claude/hooks" && printf 'mine\n' > "$r/.claude/hooks/probe.sh"
git -C "$r" add .claude && git -C "$r" "${GITC[@]}" commit -qm hook || exit 1
before=$(snap "$r")
out=$(HARNESS_PROFILE=dev sy "$r"); rc=$?
[ "$rc" = 2 ] || fail "rc=$rc $out"
printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qF '.claude/hooks/probe.sh is tracked by git' || fail "$out"
[ "$(snap "$r")" = "$before" ] || fail 'written'
printf 'ok'

cases.name: HARNESS_PROFILE gives a checkout its first profile at the start of the container, as the switcher would have
cases.cmd:
. {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{ROOT}} {{CLAUDE}} {{FIX}}/{{SID}}
need_sync; mkstg; r=$F/r; mkrepo "$r" https://github.com/acme/thing.git
out=$(HARNESS_PROFILE=dev sy "$r") || fail "$out"
[ "$(cat "$r/.claude/local/profile")" = dev ] && [ -f "$r/.claude/skills/dev-probe/SKILL.md" ] || fail "$out"
[ "$(jq -r .env.HARNESS_DEV_BATCH_GUARD "$r/.claude/settings.local.json")" = 1 ] || fail settings
printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qF 'profile dev in a source space (core source dev quality usage)' || fail "$out"
printf 'ok'

cases.name: a folder that is no workshop and no checkout, and a checkout with no profile, get nothing, and the message names HARNESS_PROFILE and workshop-profile
cases.cmd:
. {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{ROOT}} {{CLAUDE}} {{FIX}}/{{SID}}
need_sync; mkstg; mkdir -p "$F/plain" && printf 'x\n' > "$F/plain/notes.txt"; mkrepo "$F/r" https://github.com/acme/thing.git
for d in "$F/plain" "$F/r"; do
  out=$(sy "$d") || fail "$out"
  printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qF 'is not an Orkeon workshop' && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qF "HARNESS_PROFILE=dev" && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qF "'workshop-profile dev'" || fail "$out"
  [ ! -e "$d/.claude" ] || fail "written in $d"
done
printf '%s' "$(sy "$F/r")" | grep -qF '[harness] profile: user in a source space' || fail 'reason'
printf 'ok'

cases.name: a workshop that is a git repository stays a workshop; HARNESS_PROFILE=dev there is said not to apply and user deploys as before
cases.cmd:
. {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{ROOT}} {{CLAUDE}} {{FIX}}/{{SID}}
need_sync; mkstg; w=$F/w; mkrepo "$w" https://github.com/acme/workshop.git; mkws "$w"
out=$(HARNESS_PROFILE=dev sy "$w") || fail "$out"
printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qF '[harness] profile: dev in a workshop space' || fail "$out"
[ -f "$w/CLAUDE.md" ] && [ -f "$w/.claude/harness/HARNESS.md" ] && [ -d "$w/workbooks" ] && [ ! -e "$w/.claude/skills/dev-probe" ] || fail 'not the user harness'
[ ! -e "$w/.claude/.harness-space" ] && [ ! -e "$w/.claude/local/profile" ] || fail 'state written'
printf 'ok'

cases.name: definitions that cannot be read do not leave a user workshop without its harness: a warning, then every file outside packs/
cases.cmd:
. {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{ROOT}} {{CLAUDE}} {{FIX}}/{{SID}}
need_sync; mkstg; w=$F/w; mkws "$w"; printf 'name: [\n' > "$STG/profiles/packs/broken.yaml"
out=$(sy "$w") || fail "$out"
printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qF '[harness] WARNING: the profiles cannot be resolved' || fail "$out"
[ -f "$w/.claude/harness/HARNESS.md" ] && [ ! -e "$w/.claude/skills/dev-probe" ] && [ ! -e "$w/.claude/rules/source-space.md" ] || fail 'files'

cases.name: a checkout where a folder between the checkout and a target is a symbolic link (.claude/skills to a folder outside): the synchronisation refuses with exit 2, names the link, and writes nothing through it
cases.cmd:
. {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{ROOT}} {{CLAUDE}} {{FIX}}/{{SID}}
need_sync; mkstg; r=$F/r; mkrepo "$r" https://github.com/acme/thing.git; mkdir -p "$F/home" "$r/.claude/local"
printf 'dev\n' > "$r/.claude/local/profile"; ln -s "$F/home" "$r/.claude/skills"
before=$(snap "$r"); out=$(sy "$r"); rc=$?
[ "$rc" = 2 ] || fail "rc=$rc $out"
printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qF '.claude/skills is a symbolic link' || fail "$out"
[ "$(snap "$r")" = "$before" ] && [ -z "$(ls -A "$F/home")" ] || fail 'written through the link'
printf 'ok'

cases.name: a file the previous profile deployed and git now tracks is not removed by a switch: the switcher and the synchronisation refuse with exit 2, name it, and write nothing
cases.cmd:
. {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{ROOT}} {{CLAUDE}} {{FIX}}/{{SID}}
need_sync; mkstg; r=$F/r; mkrepo "$r" https://github.com/acme/thing.git
wp "$r" dev >/dev/null || fail dev
git -C "$r" add -f .claude/agents/dev-probe.md && git -C "$r" "${GITC[@]}" commit -qm keep || exit 1
before=$(snap "$r"); out=$(wp "$r" docs); rc=$?
[ "$rc" = 2 ] || fail "switcher: rc=$rc $out"
printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qF '.claude/agents/dev-probe.md is tracked by git' || fail "switcher: $out"
[ "$(snap "$r")" = "$before" ] || fail 'switcher: written'
printf 'docs\n' > "$r/.claude/local/profile"; before=$(snap "$r"); out=$(sy "$r"); rc=$?
[ "$rc" = 2 ] || fail "sync: rc=$rc $out"
printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qF '.claude/agents/dev-probe.md is tracked by git' || fail "sync: $out"
[ "$(snap "$r")" = "$before" ] || fail 'sync: written'
printf 'ok'

cases.name: two linked worktrees of one repository on two profiles keep each its own block of the info/exclude they share, keyed by the worktree's top level, and both stay clean
cases.cmd:
. {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{ROOT}} {{CLAUDE}} {{FIX}}/{{SID}}
need_sync; mkstg; r=$F/r; mkrepo "$r" https://github.com/acme/thing.git
git -C "$r" worktree add -q -b side "$F/t" 2>&1 || exit 1
printf '# mine\n' > "$r/.git/info/exclude"
wp "$r" dev >/dev/null || fail dev; wp "$F/t" docs >/dev/null || fail docs
sy "$r" --force >/dev/null || fail 'second start of r'
ex=$r/.git/info/exclude
for top in "$(git -C "$r" rev-parse --show-toplevel)" "$(git -C "$F/t" rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; do
  [ "$(grep -cxF "# >>> orkeon-workshop harness $top" "$ex")" = 1 ] && [ "$(grep -cxF "# <<< orkeon-workshop harness $top" "$ex")" = 1 ] || fail "$top: $(cat "$ex")"
done
grep -qx '/.claude/skills/dev-probe/SKILL.md' "$ex" && grep -qx '/.claude/skills/docs-audit-probe/SKILL.md' "$ex" && grep -qx '# mine' "$ex" || fail "$(cat "$ex")"
[ -z "$(git -C "$r" status --porcelain)" ] && [ -z "$(git -C "$F/t" status --porcelain)" ] || fail "git status: $(git -C "$r" status --porcelain) | $(git -C "$F/t" status --porcelain)"
printf 'ok'
